description: A document related to burial or funeral expenses, such as a funeral home invoice, burial contract, cemetery statement, or payment receipt. Used to verify burial-related household expenses.

deceased_name.instruction: The full name of the deceased person associated with the burial expense.

payer_name.instruction: The full name of the person responsible for paying the burial or funeral expense.

provider_name.instruction: The name of the funeral home, cemetery, cremation provider, or other service provider.

provider_address.instruction: The address of the burial or funeral service provider.

provider_contact.instruction: Contact information for the service provider, such as phone number or email.

document_type.instruction: Type of burial-related document, such as invoice, contract, statement, or receipt.

service_date.instruction: Date of burial, funeral, cremation, or related service. YYYY-MM-DD format.

invoice_date.instruction: Date the invoice or statement was issued. YYYY-MM-DD format.

due_date.instruction: Payment due date for the burial expense if stated. YYYY-MM-DD format.

invoice_number.instruction: Invoice, account, or reference number associated with the burial expense.

amount.instruction: The billed or paid amount for burial or funeral-related services.

payment_frequency.instruction: Payment frequency if installments are used, such as one-time, monthly, or weekly.

payment_status.instruction: Payment status, such as paid, partially paid, unpaid, or past due.

amount_paid.instruction: Amount already paid toward the burial expense if stated.

balance_due.instruction: Remaining balance due for the burial expense if stated.
